_note: Mollosar's Journal — quest definitions. Objectives complete when their GameState flag is set. Story bot: add quests here; the journal reads this file directly. Keep descriptions textbox-tight.

quests.description: The invaders are coming across Bellhollow Bridge. Hold the line — it's a memory, but it still matters.
quests.name: Hold the Bridge

quests.description: Something waits on the Black Sand Shore. A small light with wings.
quests.name: The Black Sand

quests.description: A stray soul lingers by the river. Guide it home — gently.
quests.name: The River Bounty

quests.description: The plaza's bounty board tracks every hunter's tally. Read it. Know where you stand.
quests.name: The Bounty Board

quests.description: The Soul Council has named a price on Kanryu. Fifty thousand Soul Credits and a vault item. Sealed — not for you. That's the point.
quests.name: The Kanryu Bounty

quests.description: Wrath is taking the contracts you pass up. He remembers every one.
quests.name: The Rival

quests.description: Something vast stirs on the Gloomy Path. The Silver Bell Bloom cluster trembles.
quests.name: Bloom Maw
The Cold Forge
quests.description: The blacksmith of Forgehold won't repair the armor — and won't say why. Find another way in.

quests.name: Tucker and the Sloths
quests.description: Tucker has gone down into the Warrens to ask his kin to stand with the garden. Follow — at a distance.
